description: This source file defines functions related to visualizing tensor sharding in PyTorch's distributed environment. It includes utilities for creating tables with 'tabulate' or 'rich' libraries, color handling, and the main function 'visualize_sharding' for displaying sharding layout for distributed tensors.

methods.name: _create_table( shards: list[tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int], int]], device_kind: str = "" )
methods.description: Creates a textual table representation of tensor shards using the 'tabulate' library, organizing shard info into a grid with device and block coordinates.

methods.name: make_color_iter(color_map, num_rows, num_cols)
methods.description: Generator that yields colors from a color map based on the number of tensor rows and columns.

methods.name: str _canonicalize_color(color: Color)
methods.description: Converts a Color tuple or string into a hex color string.

methods.name: str _get_text_color(color: str)
methods.description: Determines readability text color (black or white) based on background color luminance.

methods.name: _create_rich_table( shape: ShapeType, shards: list[tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int], int]], device_kind: str = "", scale: float = 1.0, min_width: int = 9, max_width: int = 80, )
methods.description: Creates a color-enhanced table visualization of tensor shards using the 'rich' library.

methods.name: visualize_sharding(dtensor, header="", use_rich: bool = False)
methods.description: Main function to visualize the sharding layout of a distributed tensor in the terminal, supporting 1D and 2D tensors with optional rich or tabulate visualization.
